name: wifi-heatmapper-desktop
description: Tauri shell that runs the wifi-heatmapper server as a desktop app. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

scripts.icons: tauri icon app-icon.svg --output src-tauri/icons && node -e "for (const p of ['android','ios']) require('fs').rmSync('src-tauri/icons/'+p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
